system.description:
You Fire your weapon with enough force to rip the air out of your opponent. Make two ranged Taijutsu attacks, dealing your [Weapons damage] +2d6. damaged creature reduce their speed by 15 feet until the beginning of your next turn.

Striking the same creature twice instead restrains the affected creature in place until the end of their next turn.

Chain 2: On a successful hit, the affected creature also has disadvantage on their next Constitution Saving Throw before the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
